Serial constraints cleared: no open PR names #24768; the dev re-measures open PRs on `packages/objectql/**` and `packages/rest/**` before `pr_create`

Claim amendment (file surface) · `domain:server#1` · seat session `session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC` · 2026-10-26T07:12Z · amends claim 6410180146, same session, same branch `claude/project-thread-otcr21`.

File surface adds, at the dev's measured request:
- `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` and its tests (one new sibling test): export ONE cause-walking dialect NOT NULL reader built from the module-private `notNullViolationSite`, so the engine reads the same dialect vocabulary (SQLite / libsql / PostgreSQL `23502` / MySQL `ER_BAD_NULL_ERROR` 1048) and objectql adds none of its own.
- Retirement of the REST relabel, since every path it served is now an engine write: `packages/rest/src/not-null-refusal-label.ts`, its two call sites in `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts` and `rest-server.ts`, the REST pins of the relabelled body (`data-not-null-field-label-24715.test.ts`, `data-not-null-hint-20963.test.ts`, moved to the engine's answer, never loosened), and the then-unused `notNullRefusalSite` / `relabelNotNullRefusal` / `declaredNotNullHint` and their WeakMap in `packages/types`. Condition: before removing an export from `@objectstack/types`, grep `ui/**`, `examples/**` and objectstack-ai/hotcrm for each name; any consumer keeps the export and is named in the report. The changeset declares the removed exports.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-not-null-refusal-24768.test.ts` (new).

⛔ Still no `packages/spec/**`.
